description: Collect NYC sale and rental listings from StreetEasy by pasting search URLs or building a search from filters. No login or cookie needed.

amenities.description: Only listings that advertise every selected amenity are returned. Leave empty for no amenity filter. Supported values: doorman, elevator, gym, laundry, washer_dryer, dishwasher, parking, pool, fireplace, central_ac, smoke_free, storage.
amenities.title: Must-have amenities

detailedMode.description: Visit each listing page to add description, amenities, building facts, agent phone/email, price history, open houses and floor plans. Adds one request per listing.
detailedMode.title: Fetch listing details

listingType.description: Sales or rentals. StreetEasy keeps the two markets separate, so one run covers one of them.
listingType.title: Listing type

locations.description: Borough or neighborhood slugs as they appear in StreetEasy URLs: manhattan, brooklyn, queens, bronx, staten-island, nyc, williamsburg, park-slope, upper-east-side, jersey-city. Used when 'Start from' is 'Build a search'.
locations.title: Locations

maxPrice.description: Highest sale price or monthly rent to include. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

maxResults.description: Listings to collect from each search URL or location before moving on.
maxResults.title: Maximum results per search

maxSqft.description: Largest interior size to include. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxSqft.title: Maximum square feet

minBaths.description: Half-bath values such as 1.5 are accepted.
minBaths.title: Minimum bathrooms

minBeds.description: 0 means studio. Leave empty for no minimum.
minBeds.title: Minimum bedrooms

minPrice.description: Lowest sale price or monthly rent to include. Leave empty for no minimum.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

minSqft.description: Smallest interior size to include. Leave empty for no minimum.
minSqft.title: Minimum square feet

mode.description: Choose how to define the search. 'Search URLs' works with links you built on streeteasy.com. 'Build a search' creates the link from the filters below.
mode.title: Start from

noFee.description: Rentals only: keep listings with no broker fee. Ignored for sales.
noFee.title: No-fee rentals only

propertyType.description: StreetEasy property-type filter. Condo and co-op are the two types the site exposes in search URLs; leave on Any for all types.
propertyType.title: Property type

sort.description: Order of results within each search.
sort.title: Sort order

startUrls.description: StreetEasy search-result URLs for sales or rentals. Apply any filters on streeteasy.com first, then paste the URL here. Used when 'Start from' is 'Search URLs'.
startUrls.title: Search URLs

title: StreetEasy Scraper Input
